// diagnostic

E1001

Unknown core module, or a Core-private `core.<area>.runtime` unit

What

Unknown core module, or a Core-private `core.<area>.runtime` unit

Why

The registered jet rule applies here. Only Core sources import `core.<area>.runtime` units.

Fix

Select a declared public core module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1001: tests/ui/core_async_loadable_retired.stderr.

Error [E1001]: There is no core module `core.async.loadable`
  --> tests/ui/core_async_loadable_retired.jet:2:17
    |
  2 | use loadable :: core.async.loadable
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `core` is compiler-known in M10, and only the frozen core modules exist
